menu_path_issues: Open logs: the path Settings > Application Settings > Logcat (enable) is incomplete. The Logcat switch (OpenLogsItem) is disabled (onChanged null, 50% opacity) until the first item in the same screen, 'Override' / 'Переопределение' (overrideProviderSettings, subtitle 'Ignore provider settings and manage manually' / 'Игнорировать настройки от провайдера и управлять вручную'), is turned on (application_setting.dart:85-100,473-495). Correct RU path: Настройки > Настройки приложения > Переопределение (вкл.) > Журналирование (вкл.) > Логи появляются в боковой панели (десктоп) или в Настройки > Еще (мобильные). The provider header 'openlogs' can also set it (controller.dart:294).

System proxy / TUN via Dashboard card: the 'System proxy', 'TUN' and 'VPN' cards are not in the default dashboard (default = announce, metainfo, outboundModeV2). They exist only after the user adds them in dashboard edit mode, so the main path should be Settings > Basic configuration > Network. TUN card and System proxy card are desktop only, VPN card Android only.

Desktop tray TUN and System proxy items are built only when connected (if trayState.isStart, tray.dart:92-110). Tray 'Start' becomes 'Stop' only after the core is running. The mode items (By rule / Global / Direct) show only if the globalmode header is not false.

Switch proxy mode: Proxies > mode icon works only when the Proxies tab exists (groups loaded) and the globalmode header is not false. Popup offers By rule and Global only. In New look the mode chip next to Update/Support has the same two items. Direct is available only in the default segmented control on the classic Dashboard or in the tray.

Choose a server: the 'Dashboard > Change Server' branch requires the card to be added and the flclashx-serverinfo header on the profile. In New look, tap the server panel (flag + name + IP) on the Dashboard to open Proxies. Choosing a node is a tap on the node in the list (not verified in this pass beyond the page navigation).
Add subscription by QR on desktop: Profiles > Add Profile > QR code opens an image picker (select an image of the QR), not the camera.

Add subscription: the sheet title is '${add}${profile}' with no space (AddProfile / ДобавитьПрофиль) in profiles.dart:37 and controller.dart:1509 (file path). The deep-link confirmation dialog (controller.dart:1367) uses 'Add Profile' with a space and text 'Adding profile from' / 'Добавляем профиль по адресу'.

Check that it is connected: on Windows/Linux the title bar shows Running/Stopped (Запущено/Остановлено), not on macOS or mobile. Classic default Dashboard also changes the button colour to green. No other textual 'Connected' label exists in the code. The path is correct as written.
missing_flows: Select the active profile: tap the profile card (radio, groupValue currentProfileId) on Profiles; only on Android TV is 'Select Profile' / 'Выбрать профиль' in the three-dot menu (profiles.dart ~140-200, 431).

Default classic Dashboard subscription card (metainfo_widget.dart) uses other keys than the table: trafficUnlimited 'Unlimited Traffic' / 'Безлимитный трафик', subscriptionEternal 'Lifetime Subscription' / 'Бессрочная подписка', expiry as 'Expires on dd.MM.yyyy' / 'Истекает dd.MM.yyyy', and a last-3-days countdown with remainingSingular 'Остался' / remainingPlural 'Осталось' plus day/hour declensions (день, дня, дней; час, часа, часов). Without a profile it shows an 'Add Profile' / 'Добавить профиль' card that opens the URL dialog.

Dashboard edit mode: the 'add' sheet (title 'Add' / 'Добавить') is the only way to add the TUN, System proxy, VPN, Change Server, Traffic usage, Network speed, IP and zashboard cards. Not in the table.

New-look Dashboard: the server panel (flag, server name, external IP once connected) opens Proxies on tap; mode chip, Update chip and Support chip sit under the service name; traffic card shows 'Remaining N days' ('Осталось N дней') (hero_connect.dart 296-480).
Profile import via deep link (flclashx / clash link): confirmation dialog title 'Add Profile' and body 'Adding profile from <url>' / 'Добавляем профиль по адресу <url>' (controller.dart:1363-1390).
Profiles toolbar has two more icon-only buttons not listed: Script ('Script' / 'Скрипт') and Sort ('Profiles sort' / 'Сортировка профилей'); profile card shows a progress spinner while updating.
Update-all error path: failures show a dialog titled 'tip' ('Подсказка' in RU) listing per-profile errors (profiles.dart:55-66).

Russian-UI inconsistencies for the RU guide: hard-coded non-localized strings exist: 'VPN' (Android toggle and card), 'DNS' (config.dart), 'zashboard' (card label) and two Russian-only buttons 'Продлить подписку' / 'Докупить трафик' that also appear in EN UI. RU 'sync' = 'Обновление' (not 'Синхронизация'). RU 'Определяю IP..' ends with two dots. RU basicConfig is 'Конфигурация ядра' while the opened page header is 'Переопределение'. RU 'Журналирование' has subtitle 'Вести журнал событий приложения', which differs in meaning from EN 'Disabling will hide the log entry'.
Dashboard cards networkSpeed and trafficUsage are not in the default layout and appear only if added; the table lists them as always-visible connected-only info.
Not verified in this pass: that the core has loaded proxy groups (so the Proxies tab appears) while disconnected, and what node-tap selection does per group type; this needs a runtime check.
caveats: Source read from a shallow clone of tag v0.4.2 (commit fabbd8ea72f26a802bc942d356f4ac5a7fd798be) in a scratchpad temp dir; no repo modified. Release v0.4.2 published 2026-07-18T10:51:50Z (latest release API; commit date 2026-07-18).
The Russian locale is present and complete for every key used above (arb/intl_ru.arb has 504 lines vs 503 in EN); no RU fallback to EN was found for the listed keys.

Hint 'Dashboard button bottom-right to enable' is WRONG for the default UI: the Dashboard nav item is 'Dashboard'/'Главная' and the connect control is a full-width play/pause button at the bottom of the Dashboard page (classic look), or a play-button/timer in 'New look' mode. There is no text label such as 'Connect', 'Connected' or 'Disconnected' on the button in either dashboard; connected state is shown only by timer/colour. On desktop Windows/Linux the title bar shows 'Running'/'Stopped' (RU 'Запущено'/'Остановлено').

The assistant must NOT say 'Connected' or 'Disconnected' as a screen label, nor 'Start'/'Connect' as a button on the Dashboard. 'Start'/'Stop' exist only in the desktop tray menu and Android shortcuts.
Icon-only controls (no visible text, only tooltip on hover/long-press): Sync (profiles), Test latency, Switch mode, Export logs, profile card three-dot menu. Describe them by icon and tooltip.

Visible UI depends on the subscription's provider headers: flclashx-globalmode=false hides all mode switching; flclashx-newboard switches to the New-look dashboard; flclashx-serverinfo controls the 'Change Server' card; support-url controls 'Support'; flclashx-buyplan/buytraffic add hard-coded Russian buttons 'Продлить подписку' / 'Докупить трафик' (not localized). A user's screen may therefore differ from the labels above; the Proxies nav tab exists only when the hasProxies setting is on, and the Logs entry only when Logcat is on (openLogs).

The 'Add profile' sheet title concatenates words without a space: 'AddProfile' / 'ДобавитьПрофиль' (profiles.dart:37). The page title opened from Settings > 'Basic configuration' ('Конфигурация ядра') is 'Override' / 'Переопределение' (tools.dart:260).

Some labels are hard-coded and identical in all languages: 'VPN' (Android toggle and Dashboard card), 'DNS', 'IPv6', 'zashboard'. TUN is only on desktop; Android uses the 'VPN' switch instead. System proxy exists on desktop; on Android the same string is the sub-option of VPN.
No 'copy subscription link' or 'share/QR of subscription' feature exists at v0.4.2. The only QR display is the Android TV 'Add from Phone' / 'Receive Subscription' dialog.
Android TV is detected at runtime (system.isAndroidTV) and uses the Android layout; TV differences found: 'Add from Phone' item and 'Select Profile' menu entry. No separate TV-only locale strings.
iOS exists in the fork's tree? Not verified and not in the recommended platform list; macOS differences: no custom title bar status (shows app name), extra 'Auto set system DNS' switch.

Not visually verified in a running app; all labels come from the arb files and the Dart code at the tag. The Dart-generated l10n (lib/l10n/l10n.dart, intl/messages_*.dart) was spot-checked against the arb for newDashboard and supportedLocales only.
The 'Requests'/'Запросы' key exists in arb but the Connections page tabs use 'Active'/'Активные' and 'Log'/'Журнал'. The RU 'Sync' is 'Обновление' (not 'Синхронизация'); RU 'Update' is 'Обновить'.
